references: Two user-supplied blue chai mug photographs, used as design references
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single custom chai-mug emblem for the upper-right corner of a personal GitHub profile. It will display around 160–180 pixels wide beside the greeting, so the silhouette and details must remain clear at this size.
Input images: the two attached blue chai-mug photographs are inspiration references for an everyday Pakistani chai mug and its flowing heart motif, not objects to reproduce exactly. Create one new original mug design, not two mugs and not a product photograph.
Primary request: a smooth, polished, logo-like illustration of a blue ceramic chai mug with a gracefully curved right-side handle, visible warm caramel-colored milk chai in the elliptical opening, a subtle thin warm ivory/gold flowing heart on the front, and two elegant blue steam strokes rising above it. Give the heart a gently extended tail, clean and understated, not a heart emoji. The steam may evoke the idea of a programming/Java cup while remaining original; do not copy Java's official logo.
Style: carefully drawn editorial brand illustration with clean vector-like contours, just enough controlled tonal modeling to suggest glazed ceramic, and smooth precise edges. Make it feel finished and personable, not a stock clip-art mug, plastic clay render, photo, busy 3D scene, or generic mascot. Keep the ceramic smooth without grain or photographic texture. The mug should have a slightly tapered body and a comfortable generous curved handle; the chai rim should read naturally in a slight elevated front view.
Color palette: use the heading's blue #2F81F7 as the primary accent, deeper cobalt #155DFC and restrained navy in the shaded ceramic, warm chai tan, and a quiet warm ivory/gold front motif. Steam is blue, solid enough to read against a dark GitHub background, with smooth tapered curves, no glow and no purple.
Composition: ONE isolated mug, complete handle and complete steam in frame, a compact balanced silhouette with the steam integrated closely above the cup. Tight comfortable crop with little transparent padding. It must sit naturally on either a light or dark README without a frame, badge, round backdrop, or rectangular tile.
Background: genuine alpha transparency around the whole emblem and inside the handle. No surface, room, white rectangle, checkerboard, white outline, halo, or broad cast shadow.
Constraints: no text, letters, code, logos, Java wordmark, brand names, watermark, saucer, spoon, flowers, extra objects, extra mugs, decoration, or neon effects.
